steps.check: Differences for this lift truck type are understood
steps.coach: Read the manual for the truck you will drive.
steps.failure: Operator misses model-specific hazards and controls.
steps.instruction: Study the operating manual supplied with the lift truck.

steps.check: Checklist is in hand and truck is evaluated for lockout
steps.coach: If it looks unsafe, lock it out and tell your supervisor.
steps.failure: Unsafe truck stays in service and causes injury.
steps.instruction: Take the inspection checklist and inspect the forklift at start of shift; report damage and lock out and tag if unsafe.

steps.check: Tread is intact and inflation looks correct
steps.coach: Feel the tread and look for cuts.
steps.failure: Tire failure causes tipover or loss of load.
steps.instruction: Visually and manually inspect pneumatic tire condition and inflation.

steps.coach: Check every light before you move.
steps.failure: Truck is not visible to others in the yard.
steps.instruction: Inspect all running lights for operation.

steps.check: Battery is clean, connected, and undamaged
steps.coach: Look only, let trained staff service batteries.
steps.failure: Acid burn, short, or no-start from bad battery.
steps.instruction: Inspect battery condition without servicing it.

steps.check: Truck moves forward and reverse on command
steps.failure: Unexpected travel or no directional control.
steps.instruction: Press the forward and reverse direction pedal to check operation.

steps.check: Lift and tilt respond smoothly to levers
steps.coach: Work each lever through its travel.
steps.failure: Load cannot be lifted or tilted safely.
steps.instruction: Pull the lift and tilt control levers to check function.

steps.check: Forks are straight, latched, and functional
steps.coach: Check both forks and the latch.
steps.instruction: Inspect forks and load engaging devices for proper operation.

steps.check: No pinch points, cuts, or worn spots seen
steps.coach: Shut it down first, then look close.
steps.instruction: With forklift shut down, visually check hydraulic hoses for pinch points and worn spots.

steps.check: Chains are seated and cotter pins are in place
steps.coach: Confirm every pin is still there.
steps.instruction: Check lift chains and verify cotter pins are in place.

steps.check: Carriage bolts are tight and secure
Paper stays dry with no fluid spots
steps.coach: Use paper only, never your hand.
steps.failure: High-pressure leak injects fluid into skin.
steps.instruction: With forklift on and under pressure, run a piece of paper over hose surfaces to check for fluid leaks.

steps.failure: Truck cannot stop and strikes people.
steps.instruction: Press the service brake pedal to verify brakes work.
Turn the steering wheel to verify steering mechanism is okay.

steps.check: Fuel connections and gauge show operational system
steps.coach: Look for leaks at the tank.
steps.failure: Fuel leak causes fire or stall.
steps.instruction: Inspect the fuel system including propane tank and fittings.

steps.check: All inspection boxes are marked on the log
steps.coach: Log it every shift, no shortcuts.
steps.failure: No verifiable record and problems are missed.
steps.instruction: Mark the inspection log for the forklift.
